content:
jess_sales: Heads-up from FinCorp procurement: they want a 30-day air-gapped POC, USB-only delivery to their isolated cluster, signed artifact + SBOM, PKCS#11 HSM integration (Entrust nShield), documented offline cert rotation, and explicit contract language about upgrade cadence and rollback liability. They also asked for a single fixed price for the POC. Who needs to be pulled in?

devin_se: USB-only is fine. We'll produce a signed tarball (cosign/X.509) and an SPDX SBOM. Will include a small `verify.sh` that runs local signature + checksum checks. For HSM integration, confirm whether they have a PKCS#11 socket exposed on the host or if they expect us to ship an adapter. If socket is local (typical), our agent can call PKCS#11.

leo_fieldeng: Delivery plan: build `redwood-poc-3.1.0.tar.gz` + `sbom-3.1.0.spdx` + detached sig `redwood-3.1.0.sig` and a manifest.json. We'll sign using our signing key; if customer requires signing using their key we can accept BYO cert. Example manifest: 

```
{"version":"1","components":[{"name":"runtime","file":"redwood-3.1.0.tar.gz","sha256":"aa11bb..."},{"name":"sbom","file":"sbom-3.1.0.spdx"}],"signature":"redwood-3.1.0.sig"}
```
We'll also provide `preflight.sh` to run on the install host and `apply-rotation.sh` for cert swaps.

samira_sec: Security notes: monthly patches is aggressive for air-gapped flow. Propose contract language: "Quarterly non-security updates; security hotfix SLA: 72h triage, signed delta delivery within 5 business days", and an optional accelerated patch subscription for monthly cadence. For bundle attestation: we can provide signing cert chain + timestamped signatures. If they insist on FIPS 140-2 proof for signing HSM, we need to know if their legal accepts our compliance attestation or requires an HSM vendor cert. Also note: cosign transparency log usage needs egress; if they need proof, they must allow a controlled proxy or we must provide offline attestation artifact.

omar_ops: Ops constraints from them: SELinux Enforcing, containerd only, kernel >= 5.10, /var/lib/redwood >= 600GB, single operator account to mount USB, no outbound network. We'll need the HSM admin to confirm socket path and permissions. Acceptance tests they want: start, healthcheck, simple chat generation, and an embedding run. Who signs acceptance? We'll need an named approver.

jess_sales: Pricing ask: they want fixed POC fee including packaging and validation. What are standard numbers?

devin_se: Typical NRE for air-gapped packaging + SBOM + verify tooling = 2-3 engineer-days. POC license: 30 days at 60% of base monthly. On-site work or accelerated turnaround is extra. I'll draft a quote.

leo_fieldeng: Timeline: 7 business days to produce signed bundle + SBOM + preflight if we get HSM socket spec and sample certs now. Hotfix patch flow: 2-3 business days for delta signed patch. Blockers: (1) confirm USB vs jumpbox copy workflow, (2) HSM socket path or adapter spec, (3) acceptance test signer and test credentials, (4) approved CA list for signing or permission to use our signing cert.

samira_sec: Contract checklist: security contact, escalation path, acceptance signer, and liability cap for POC. Also request they confirm whether they will accept our attestation or require vendor HSM proof.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-2699 - "FinCorp air-gapped POC: USB delivery, nShield PKCS#11 integration, signed bundle + SBOM" (assignees: devin_se, leo_fieldeng). Link: https://redwood.internal/INF-2699

jess_sales: Thanks all. I'll ask FinCorp to confirm USB-only vs jumpbox copy, provide HSM admin contact and acceptance signer, and we'll circulate the draft quote and proposed SLA language. Will update thread when they reply. :white_check_mark:
